# Generated native building deltas. Supply tax is separate from direct local bonuses.
# Base construction days precede engine speed modifiers.
# Province scope. All numeric fields default to zero. Known signals a catalog entry, not a complete simulation.

# Bind a new holding type to its native primary district building.
dau_economy_bind_holding_profile_effect = {
    clear_saved_scope = dau_economy_building
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:dau_economy_holding }
        switch = {
            trigger = scope:dau_economy_holding
            holding_type:castle_holding = { building_type:castle_01 = { save_scope_as = dau_economy_building } }
            holding_type:church_holding = { building_type:temple_01 = { save_scope_as = dau_economy_building } }
            holding_type:city_holding = { building_type:city_01 = { save_scope_as = dau_economy_building } }
            holding_type:herder_holding = { building_type:herder_camp_01 = { save_scope_as = dau_economy_building } }
            holding_type:nomad_holding = { building_type:nomadic_camp_01 = { save_scope_as = dau_economy_building } }
            holding_type:temple_citadel_holding = { building_type:temple_citadel_01 = { save_scope_as = dau_economy_building } }
            holding_type:tribal_holding = { building_type:tribe_01 = { save_scope_as = dau_economy_building } }
            fallback = { }
        }
    }
}
